editorial.blurb: Mixteco Grill delivers fresh, expertly grilled Mexican fare in a peaceful casual spot where portions are generous and every sauce tastes homemade.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the shrimp burrito and ask for it cooked on the flattop for a crispy outer shell, or go for the carne asada fajitas—regulars swear by both, especially when dining solo for a calm atmosphere.
